ShortDescription.Value: Asset-level vehicle restrictions for road and rail nodes or segments

Publish.LongDescription: RouteFilter lets Cities: Skylines II players restrict individual vehicle assets at a network node or across an entire road or rail segment. Matching vehicles request a different route when the restriction is detected ahead.
Publish.ChangeLog: Rebuilt the asset UI, added target overlays, contextual filtering, vehicle details, and engine-carriage groups.
